title: OutcomeBound explorable source header v1
description: The header of an explorable source: the JSON in its first element, `<script type="application/json" data-explorable>`, which `outcomebound explorable build` reads. Python checks beside this schema hold what it cannot say: `brief` is required for a decision and refused for the other kinds, it is a bounded path relative to the source's folder, and nothing comes before the header.

kind.description: What the page is: a decision explorable puts decision briefs in a form the person can explore; a learning one teaches a mechanism by questions; an interview one asks the questions the work waits on.

id.description: The page's id: it heads the person's reply and keys the values the browser saves.

title.description: The page's title, in one line.

brief.description: A decision's only: the path of the brief document `outcomebound brief` reads, relative to the source's folder and inside it.
